---
title: "Course Exit Survey"
---

```{r}
#| label: lab-course-exit-survey
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

# The survey screenshot is shared with the theory chapter
# (24_student_feedback_survey.qmd): 24_student_feedback_survey/2.png.
chapter_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
survey_image <- file.path("24_student_feedback_survey", "2.png")

if (file.exists(file.path(chapter_dir, survey_image))) {
  # Path relative to the QMD directory (an absolute path breaks the PDF build).
  cat("![](<", survey_image, ">){width=95%}\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("*Course exit survey image not available. Add it as `Course File Resources/24_student_feedback_survey/2.png`.*\n\n")
}
```
